Name: Deluxe Grabber Redux 1.6
Author: Nykal145
Description:
[size=6][b]I no longer have time to maintain this mod, there is a more up to date version [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43136]here[/url] with more features and bug fixes, I am locking bug reports and comments.[/b][/size]

This mod is just an updated version of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7920/?tab=description]Deluxe Grabber Redux[/url]﻿ mod by ferdaber. The codebase is his with my only contribution being to update it (poorly) to work on stardew valley 1.6. If you are the original mod owner of the aforementioned mod you can contact me at any time to take this down.

This was originally only created for my personal use because I love the original mod and consider it essential to my play through of the new update but due to the outcry I saw for the mod to be updated I decided to release it here. I highly HIGHLY suggest backing up your save before adding this mod and I don't take any responsibility if something goes wrong.

I don't have a github for the code yet, I'm still debating releasing it as the original code isn't licensed but I will probably release it if there is enough desire for it.

I added the global option, be careful as it might impact performance.

[b][size=4]New Features:[/size][/b]
Optional Seed Spot Grabber
Optional Moss Grabber
